result.topic_en: Draft notes on explaining gravitation and light by a hypothetical substance that continuously fills space and streams into ponderable atoms, where it passes from the material world into the mental world; also notes on absolute space, absolute time and the causes of motion.

items.english: Both hypotheses can be replaced by the single one that in all ponderable atoms matter continually passes from the material world into the mental world.

items.quote:
Die Ursache, [-...-] weshalb der Stoff dort verschwindet, ist zu suchen in der unmittelbar vorher dort
gebildeten Geistessubstanz, und die ponderablen Körper sind hienach der Ort, wo

items.english: The cause why the matter vanishes there is to be sought in the mental substance formed there immediately before, and ponderable bodies are accordingly the place where the mental world intervenes in the material world.

items.quote:

[-Raum-] stetig erfüllenden Stoffes und zwar nehme ich an, dass die [-Richtung der-] Bewegung nach Grösse und Richtung der
von ihr zu erklärenden Kraft gleich ist.
items.english: I now seek this cause in the form of motion of a substance continuously filling space, and I assume that the motion is equal in magnitude and direction to the force it is meant to explain.

items.quote:
Diese beiden Erscheinungen, Gravitation u. Licht {+bewegung+}, aber sind die einzigen, welche bloss durch den leeren Raum
durch Stoff erklärt werden müssten.
items.english: These two phenomena, gravitation and the motion of light, are however the only ones that would have to be explained through empty space by this substance.
